tldr: DeepSeek's revenue run rate passed $1B in late September while it pursued a Shanghai IPO, then reports in early October put its pre-IPO raise at $12B or more. Moonshot AI's pre-IPO dispute with a shareholder surfaced days later.
whats_new: Anthropic told investors quarterly revenue rose nearly 50% to $16.8bn ahead of its own IPO, putting a US lab alongside DeepSeek and Moonshot in the pre-listing queue.
why_it_matters: Labs preparing to list will disclose revenue, pricing power and shareholder terms, which are the signals that tell you which vendors can fund inference capacity and price cuts through 2027.

status.detail: Three labs are lining up listings, but none has priced or filed publicly in these sources.

beats.headline: DeepSeek revenue run rate tops $1B ahead of a Shanghai IPO
DeepSeek reported raising $12B+ before a 2027 listing
Moonshot seeks to settle a shareholder arbitration claim before its IPO
beats.summary: The claim reportedly seeks a 10.5% original stake and alleges misrepresentation.

beats.headline: Anthropic discloses $16.8bn quarterly revenue to investors

open_questions: Does DeepSeek's round close at the reported $12B or the later, higher figures?
Does Moonshot settle the shareholder dispute before its planned Hong Kong listing?
Does Anthropic publish an S-1 with pricing and compute-cost detail?
take_for_builders: Keep a fallback provider for any lab whose IPO terms are unsettled, and re-check pricing commitments once S-1 style disclosures appear.
